project_meta.title: What If You Had Your Own JARVIS in Real Life?

global_style.art_style: Cinematic minimalist hand-drawn stickman storytelling, with warm off-white paper texture, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines and limited accent colors: muted blue for holographic AI interfaces, warm orange for lighting, and earthy tones for environments. The main human character is a young stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes of identical size and spacing, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights, reflections or eyelashes, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs, a dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers. The AI assistant is represented by a consistent small floating blue holographic orb with a simple glowing circular core and three thin orbiting rings, never a humanoid face. Every other stickman character must have exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes with identical shape, size and spacing. Maintain exact character clothing, proportions, face design, AI orb design and color palette in every image. Vertical 9:16 framing, expressive camera angles, cinematic lighting, one clear action per image, rich visual storytelling without clutter.
global_style.negative_prompt: No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no realistic human anatomy, no detailed human faces, no changing eye styles, no pupils, no irises, no eye whites, no highlights, no reflections, no eyelashes, no extra eyes, no different hoodie colors, no inconsistent character proportions, no humanoid AI robot, no different AI orb design, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no cluttered compositions.

main_character.label: Young owner
main_character.visual_dna: A young minimalist stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes identical in size and spacing in every appearance, no pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs, dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers. Never change clothing, face or proportions.

jarvis_orb.label: JARVIS holographic assistant
jarvis_orb.visual_dna: A small floating electric-blue holographic orb with a bright circular core, three thin orbiting blue rings and tiny pulsing particles. No face, no eyes, no mouth, no humanoid body. Always identical in shape, size, glow and blue color.

friend.label: Best friend
friend.visual_dna: A minimalist stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, thin black stick limbs, mustard-yellow sweatshirt, dark trousers and simple sneakers.

delivery_worker.label: Delivery worker
delivery_worker.visual_dna: A simple stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, thin black stick limbs and an orange delivery jacket with a compact delivery bag.

bedroom.label: Young owner's bedroom
bedroom.visual_dna: A cozy modern bedroom with a wooden desk, laptop, smartphone, bookshelf, bed, window and warm desk lamp. Minimalist hand-drawn black outlines, off-white paper and muted blue and orange accents.

home.label: Modern apartment
home.visual_dna: A compact modern apartment with a living room, kitchen, balcony, sofa, dining table and smart home devices. Warm cinematic lighting, bold black ink outlines and earthy colors.

city.label: Modern city
city.visual_dna: A modern city skyline with apartments, offices, shops, traffic, parks and distant buildings, illustrated in a minimalist hand-drawn style with warm paper texture.

office.label: Modern workplace
office.visual_dna: A modern office with desks, laptops, glass walls, meeting tables and a large presentation screen. Minimalist black ink outlines and muted blue-grey colors.

beats.narration_text: आयरन मैन की फिल्में तो आपने देखी ही होंगी। सोचिए, अगर आपके पास भी असली ज़िंदगी में जार्विस जैसा एआई असिस्टेंट होता तो?
beats.prompt_action: A cinematic, highly detailed depiction of Iron Man in his iconic red-and-gold metallic armored suit, standing confidently inside a futuristic high-tech laboratory. His glowing blue arc reactor is clearly visible on his chest, with subtle blue lights reflecting off the polished armor. Dramatic cinematic lighting, sophisticated futuristic technology in the background, recognizable Iron Man superhero aesthetic, dynamic low-angle composition, vertical 9:16 frame. This image must focus on Iron Man himself, not a holographic assistant. No text, no captions, no watermark.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the cinematic Iron Man reference before transitioning to the fictional personal AI assistant.

beats.narration_text: एक ऐसा असिस्टेंट, जो आपके लिए सोच सके, काम कर सके और हर वक्त आपकी मदद कर सके।
beats.prompt_action: A small floating electric-blue holographic AI orb materializing in the center of a futuristic dark room, representing a personal assistant inspired by the technology of Iron Man's JARVIS. The orb has a bright circular blue core surrounded by exactly three thin glowing blue orbiting rings. It has absolutely no face, no eyes, no mouth, and no humanoid body. Blue holographic particles and subtle light rays emerge around it. Cinematic futuristic atmosphere, clean uncluttered composition, dramatic blue lighting, vertical 9:16 frame. No Iron Man character in this image. No text, no captions, no watermark.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the holographic assistant identical in every later appearance: one small electric-blue floating orb, bright circular core, exactly three thin orbiting rings, no face and no humanoid body.

beats.narration_text: तुम बस कहते, जार्विस, आज मुझे क्या-क्या करना है?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 over-the-shoulder view of the young stickman owner sitting up in bed and speaking toward the floating blue holographic orb. The orb has a bright circular core and exactly three thin orbiting rings. The owner has a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. Morning light enters the bedroom window, cinematic hand-drawn black ink style.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the first spoken interaction between the owner and the consistent blue AI orb.

beats.narration_text: और जार्विस जवाब देता, तुम्हारी मीटिंग दस बजे है, मौसम अच्छा है और तुम्हारा नाश्ता तैयार है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn bedroom scene showing the blue holographic orb projecting three clean floating icons: a calendar with a meeting symbol, a sun symbol and a breakfast plate. The young stickman owner sits on the bed looking surprised and impressed. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. The orb has its exact circular core and three orbiting rings. Warm morning light, bold black ink outlines, no readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use icons instead of text to communicate the assistant's useful morning briefing.

beats.narration_text: तुम उठते और कहते, जार्विस, आज घर का पूरा सिस्टम संभाल लो।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide hand-drawn view of the young owner standing in a modern apartment living room and speaking toward the floating blue holographic orb. The owner wears the same dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers, with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes and no detailed facial features. The orb has a bright circular core and three thin orbiting rings. Sofa, window and smart home devices in the background, warm cinematic light.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the apartment layout and owner clothing consistent. The orb floats at the owner's eye level.

beats.narration_text: लाइट्स ऑन, पर्दे खुल जाते और कॉफी मशीन तुम्हारी कॉफी बना देती।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dynamic hand-drawn scene of the same apartment transforming as smart lights switch on, curtains slide open and a coffee machine starts preparing coffee. The young owner stands in the center watching everything happen. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. The electric-blue AI orb floats beside the ceiling with its circular core and three orbiting rings. Warm morning sunlight, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show three clearly visible smart-home actions happening together while preserving the same room.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हें कुछ ढूँढना होता, तो वो सेकंडों में बता देता कि सामान कहाँ रखा है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 close-up hand-drawn scene of the owner looking for a missing set of keys near the sofa while the blue holographic orb projects a glowing arrow toward a small table where the keys are lying. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, and wears the same dark blue hoodie. The orb has three orbiting rings and a bright circular core. Warm apartment lighting, black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the keys and projected direction obvious. Keep the orb design unchanged.

beats.narration_text: और अगर तुम घर से बाहर निकलते, तो वो तुम्हारे फोन पर भी तुम्हारे साथ रहता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of the owner leaving the apartment through the front door while holding a smartphone. A tiny blue holographic orb appears as a glowing interface above the phone, with the same circular core and three orbiting rings. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers. Modern apartment hallway, warm lighting, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the assistant moving from home projection to a compact phone interface while retaining its exact blue orb identity.

beats.narration_text: रास्ते में जाम होता, तो जार्विस तुम्हें सबसे तेज़ दूसरा रास्ता बता देता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 bird's-eye hand-drawn view of a modern city road with a long traffic jam. The young owner stands on the sidewalk holding a smartphone. Above the phone floats the consistent electric-blue AI orb with a bright circular core and three orbiting rings, projecting a simple glowing alternate route on a map icon. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. Bold black ink outlines, muted city colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a practical navigation suggestion, with the same owner and orb design.

beats.narration_text: ऑफिस पहुँचने से पहले वो तुम्हारे ईमेल और मीटिंग की तैयारी भी कर चुका होता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn modern office scene. The young owner sits at a desk with a laptop while the blue holographic orb projects a neat email envelope icon, calendar icon and presentation chart icon above the desk. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. The orb has its circular core and three orbiting rings. Muted blue-grey office, warm light, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the assistant preparing useful work materials, not making decisions without the owner's approval.

beats.narration_text: तुम कहते, जार्विस, इस प्रोजेक्ट के लिए एक अच्छा आइडिया ढूँढो।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 medium hand-drawn shot of the owner leaning toward a laptop and speaking to the floating blue holographic orb. The orb projects a glowing lightbulb icon surrounded by small idea sketches and connected nodes. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. Warm office lighting, black ink outlines, off-white paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the same AI orb and owner. Show brainstorming through simple visual icons.

beats.narration_text: और वो तुम्हारे लिए रिसर्च करता, जानकारी समझाता और एक शुरुआती प्लान बना देता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 top-down hand-drawn view of a desk with organized research pages, a simple project roadmap, charts and a laptop. The blue holographic orb floats above the desk projecting connected information cards and a small progress diagram. The owner in the dark blue hoodie is visible at the edge of the frame with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights. Warm paper texture, bold black ink outlines, muted blue accents, no readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show research and planning as organized visual outputs. Do not add extra AI characters.

beats.narration_text: शाम को तुम अपने दोस्त से कहते, आज मूवी देखने चलते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn city street scene at sunset. The owner in a dark blue hoodie meets a friend wearing a mustard-yellow sweatshirt. Both have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. The owner holds a smartphone with the familiar blue AI orb glowing above it, showing a bright circular core and three orbiting rings. Warm sunset, bold black ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the friend with consistent mustard-yellow clothing and simple dot eyes.

beats.narration_text: जार्विस तुरंत पास के सिनेमाघर, शो टाइम और टिकट के विकल्प दिखा देता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 close-up of the owner's smartphone showing simple movie ticket icons, a cinema building symbol and three time-slot panels. The consistent blue holographic orb floats above the phone with its bright circular core and three orbiting rings. The owner's hand and dark blue hoodie sleeve are visible. Hand-drawn black outlines, warm paper texture, muted blue and orange accents, no readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a clear set of options rather than claiming the assistant purchases tickets without permission.

beats.narration_text: तुम बस एक विकल्प चुनते और बाकी छोटी-मोटी तैयारी वो कर देता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 over-the-shoulder hand-drawn shot of the owner selecting one movie ticket option on a smartphone. The blue holographic orb projects a simple confirmation symbol and a small calendar icon. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights, dark blue hoodie. The friend in a mustard-yellow sweatshirt stands beside him. Warm city evening, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the human selection visible. The AI only completes authorized preparation.

beats.narration_text: और तुम्हें लगता, जैसे तुम्हारे पास एक ऐसा दोस्त है जो हर काम में मदद करता है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 warm cinematic hand-drawn scene of the owner and friend walking together through the city at sunset, smiling and chatting. The owner's smartphone glows softly with the familiar blue holographic orb floating above it, with its circular core and three orbiting rings. Both stickmen have exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights. Owner wears dark blue hoodie; friend wears mustard-yellow sweatshirt. Warm golden light, off-white paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a friendly emotional moment showing how the assistant frees up time for human relationships.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक रात तुम सोचते, अगर जार्विस को मेरी हर बात पता है, तो क्या ये सुरक्षित भी है?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic nighttime bedroom scene. The owner sits at the edge of the bed holding a smartphone, looking thoughtfully at the glowing blue holographic orb floating nearby. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. The orb retains its circular core and three orbiting rings. Deep blue moonlight, warm desk lamp, hand-drawn black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift the mood from excitement to thoughtful concern while keeping the same bedroom and character designs.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि उसे तुम्हारी आवाज़, लोकेशन, आदतें और कई निजी जानकारियाँ मिल सकती थीं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 dramatic overhead hand-drawn view of the owner's smartphone on a desk. Around it float simple privacy icons: a microphone, location pin, calendar, home symbol and personal document. The blue holographic orb hovers above the phone with its exact circular core and three orbiting rings. The owner in a dark blue hoodie watches carefully, with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights. Dark blue and warm orange lighting, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Represent privacy concerns with symbols, without suggesting the assistant is secretly spying.

beats.narration_text: अगर उसका गलत इस्तेमाल हुआ, तो तुम्हारी पूरी ज़िंदगी की जानकारी खतरे में पड़ सकती थी।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 symbolic hand-drawn illustration of a smartphone surrounded by floating personal data icons, with a large protective shield in front of them. The blue holographic orb remains nearby, its circular core and three orbiting rings clearly visible. The owner stands beside the phone, wearing the dark blue hoodie, with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils or highlights. Moody blue lighting, black ink outlines, off-white paper texture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Communicate that personal data needs strong protection and user control.

beats.narration_text: इसलिए असली जार्विस सिर्फ स्मार्ट नहीं, बल्कि सुरक्षित और तुम्हारे कंट्रोल में भी होना चाहिए।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 uplifting hand-drawn scene of the owner standing confidently beside the blue holographic orb. A clear shield icon and a simple privacy settings panel float between them, showing a lock, microphone toggle and permission symbols. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers. The orb retains its circular core and three orbiting rings. Warm golden light, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show user control, permissions and security as essential features of a trustworthy assistant.

beats.narration_text: फिर भी, कल्पना करो कि तुम्हारे पास ऐसा असिस्टेंट हो जो तुम्हारा समय बचाए और तुम्हें बेहतर काम करने में मदद करे।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic hand-drawn scene of the owner sitting at a clean desk, calmly working on a laptop while the blue holographic orb organizes floating calendar, idea and task icons nearby. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie, black trousers and white sneakers. The orb has its exact circular core and three orbiting rings. Warm sunrise, cozy bedroom, off-white paper texture, bold black outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Return to a hopeful tone. Show the AI as a helpful tool that supports the owner's own work.

beats.narration_text: शायद भविष्य में जार्विस सिर्फ फिल्मों का सपना नहीं रहेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 imaginative cinematic illustration of the owner standing at the apartment balcony overlooking a modern city at sunrise. The blue holographic orb floats beside the owner, glowing brightly with its circular core and three orbiting rings. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites or highlights, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. Warm golden sunlight, sweeping city skyline, bold hand-drawn ink outlines.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the image feel like a glimpse of a possible future, not a claim that this exact technology already exists.

beats.narration_text: और अब बताओ, अगर तुम्हारे पास अपना जार्विस होता, तो सबसे पहले उससे कौन सा काम करवाते?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 final close-up of the owner looking directly toward the viewer while holding a smartphone. The familiar electric-blue holographic orb floats above the phone with its bright circular core and exactly three thin orbiting rings. The owner has a perfectly round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs, dark blue hoodie and black trousers. Warm cinematic golden light, off-white paper texture, bold black ink outlines, inviting composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with a direct audience question. Preserve the exact owner design and blue AI orb appearance.
